cache_and_resource_notes: Candidate fast artifact was reused from the Implementer run after exact model-name, diagnostics, score, and record-count checks.
Compatible incumbent iteration and validation artifacts from the leaderboard were reused after raw JSON model-name and diagnostics checks.
Candidate iteration reported chunks=229 cached=0 pending=229, so the candidate iteration metrics are from a fresh fixed evaluation run.
Candidate iteration reported GPU dispatch mode with requested_workers=4, effective_workers=4, gpu_count=4, worker_devices=0:0,1:1,2:2,3:3.
A mid-run GPU snapshot showed all four GPUs at 100% utilization with about 17.4 GiB used and about 5.2 GiB free on each.
No evaluation command failures, diagnostic issues, nonfinite outputs, resource warnings, or restarts occurred.
measurement_lessons: Evaluation JSON files include persistence rows, so all candidate/incumbent comparisons filtered records by exact model_name before guardrail calculations.
The dry-DFI split produced metrics that were nearly identical to the incumbent, with a small positive primary delta far below the fixed iteration promotion threshold.
The largest iteration RMSE regression was only about 0.0065% for geopotential_500 at 48 hours, so the measured failure is effect size, not diagnostics or guardrail stability.
Validation was not run because the iteration promotion gate did not pass.
